name: ovos-n8n-jarvis-softphone
description: A Flask-based API bridge that connects Baresip (SIP client) with Twilio's conference calling system, enabling seamless integration between local SIP infrastructure and cloud-based telephony services.
author: reklis

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
### 1. Clone the Repository

git clone <repository-url>
cd ovos-n8n-jarvis-softphone

### 2. Install Dependencies

Using uv (recommended):
uv sync

Or using pip:
pip install -r requirements.txt

### 3. Environment Configuration

Create a `.env` file in the project root:

setup_notes.heading: Twilio Configuration
setup_notes.content:
TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=your_account_sid
TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=your_auth_token
TWILIO_CALLER_ID=+1234567890
TWILIO_SIP_URI=+1234567890@yourdomain.pstn.twilio.com
TWILIO_PSTN_DOMAIN=yourdomain.pstn.twilio.com

### 4. Baresip Configuration

Ensure Baresip is configured with:
- Console port enabled (default: 5555)
- SIP account configured
- Network access to Twilio SIP endpoints

## Usage

### Running the API Server

#### Development Mode
python app.py

#### Production Mode (using uv)

setup_notes.heading: uv will automatically install dependencies in .venv
setup_notes.content:
uv run python app.py

#### As a systemd service

setup_notes.heading: TwiML Configuration
setup_notes.content:
The project includes an example `twiml.xml` file for Twilio webhook configuration.
Configure this TwiML in your Twilio sip domain endpoint bucket.
